dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pv06](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pv06) Magnitude 6.3 earthquake at 35.0 depth occurred on Apr 25 2025 20km NE of Esmeraldas. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 1.1049 longitude -79.5345. It impacted 81316 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
